My dear Madam,
I wish I could give you a more agreeable answer, but I am afraid that there is no space available in the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) for your contributions which could hardly find admittance soon enough to answer to your present wishes
I am afraid too that I have too many sketches of travels already on my hands

Yours truly

C M Yonge
